notes.title: User Feedback Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the stage "Dreary Dungeon" would not let you quit.
Fixed an issue where bumpers and slingshots were not interactable on the pinball stages.
Fixed an issue where character models could block interacting with the board.
Various U.I. Adjustments to help with different monitor resolutions.
